cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID. Children are not yet enrolled. TZA-001's 943,284 is a Zanzibar count, not a national one.
cells.note: The September 2026 count of 27.5 million registered is about 39% of the population, and 23.5 million with a number about 33%. The October 2026 figure of 943,284 is Zanzibar's, so it does not stand as the newest national count.
